name: Stop orphaned Podman query
command: set -euo pipefail; env_file="${UA_WHATBOX_ENV_FILE:-${XDG_CONFIG_HOME:-$HOME/.config}/upload-assistant/whatbox.env}"; set -a; source "$env_file"; set +a; export SSHPASS="$UA_WHATBOX_PASSWORD"; timeout 45 sshpass -e ssh -4 -o ConnectTimeout=10 -o ServerAliveInterval=5 -o ServerAliveCountMax=2 -o PubkeyAuthentication=no -o PreferredAuthentications=password -o StrictHostKeyChecking=yes artemisprime@destiny.whatbox.ca 'kill -9 1006844 1006871 2>/dev/null || true; echo orphan_query_stopped; ps -eo pid,ppid,stat,args | grep -E "[p]odman|[c]onmon|[h]elmd" | head -50'
description: Stop the remaining orphaned Podman query without invoking the wedged runtime.
